Parco — Mobile Parking Platform

Mobile Mobility iOS / Android 2024

Parco is a mobile parking platform that enables cashless, ticket-free, pay-per-minute parking across hundreds of cities in Germany and Austria. The product operates within complex municipal regulations while serving users in time-critical, high-stress urban contexts.

We focused on translating regulatory complexity into a clear, fast, and trustworthy end-to-end experience.

Problem space

Urban parking is defined by:

  • Fragmented city rules and pricing models
  • High cognitive load at the moment of use
  • User anxiety around time limits, fines, and overpaying

Most parking systems optimize for enforcement rather than user understanding.

Key product features

  • Start & stop parking sessions
  • Minutely billing — users only pay for actual parking time
  • Cashless payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, SEPA)
  • Visibility into parking availability and busyness
  • City-wide coverage across Germany & Austria
  • Smart reminders before parking expires
  • Navigation to parking area and final destination

Design approach

We shaped a parking experience that prioritizes speed, clarity, and user confidence — translating complex municipal parking rules into a simple mobile flow for real-world, time-pressured situations.

  • Simplified user flows for starting and stopping parking sessions
  • Designed for edge cases: overstay anxiety, unclear zones, and payment trust
  • Surfaced real-time parking availability to help users predict where to find a spot
  • Balanced legal and municipal constraints with consumer-grade UX standards
  • Defined a modern, playful visual tone to reduce stress in urban contexts

User values

Reduced cognitive load

No meters, tickets, or guessing parking duration — users stay in control at all times.

Fair pricing & trust

Minutely billing eliminates overpaying and increases confidence in the system.

Stress-free urban mobility

Visibility into availability and busyness helps users predict where to find a spot, reducing uncertainty and unnecessary circling.

Flexibility in unpredictable situations

One-tap extensions and reminders adapt to real-life delays.
